The model is a byte-register map (WHO_AM_I 0x6A, address 0x6A) with little-endian signed outputs at the datasheet sensitivities 0.061 mg/LSB (±2 g), 8.75 mdps/LSB (±245 dps) and 25 + raw/256 °C; the driver configures CTRL3_C, CTRL1_XL and CTRL2_G per DocID028475. The Click ships set to SPI, so the notes say to move the four COMM SEL jumpers to I2C.
